# TD LIST

-   prioritise interactions with TSS

-   relevant GO terms (chromatin genes)
-   HuGeAMP BioIndex relevant gwas term
-   column specifying strongest non-tss interaction
-   druggable

```{r genes}

gene_bodies <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/capoverlaps/sig_mpcc_gene_tss_5kbp.bed")

unique_genes <- distinct(gene_bodies, V11, .keep_all = TRUE)


#### chicane on 5e6 max distance
gene_bodies_chicane <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/CHiCANE/M1_results_005_gene_tss_5kbp.bed")

unique_genes_chicane <- distinct(gene_bodies_chicane, V18, .keep_all = TRUE)
table(unique_genes$V11 %in% unique_genes_chicane$V18)

which(unique_genes$V11 %in% unique_genes_chicane$V18)

unique_genes[which(unique_genes$V11 %in% unique_genes_chicane$V18)]


#### chicane on peaky distances

gene_bodies_chicane_peaky <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/CHiCANE/M1_results_005_gene_tss_5kbp_peaky_distances.bed")

unique_genes_chicane_peaky <- distinct(gene_bodies_chicane_peaky, V18, .keep_all = TRUE)
table(unique_genes$V11 %in% unique_genes_chicane_peaky$V18)

which(unique_genes$V11 %in% unique_genes_chicane_peaky$V18)

unique_genes[which(unique_genes$V11 %in% unique_genes_chicane_peaky$V18)]

```

```{r eQTL}

# eQTL check --------------------------------------------------------------

# the eQTL files are massive so instead of loading them into R, process in the command line
# wrangle so the first 3 columns are the baits, bc we want to know if the eQTLs at the bait predict the genes overlapped
eQTL_unique_genes <- unique_genes %>% 
    relocate(c(V5, V6, V7), .before = V1)

#write_tsv(as.data.frame(eQTL_unique_genes), "peaky_called_unique_genes.bed", col_names = F)

# bedtools intersect -wo -a Adipose_Subcutaneous_snps_lifted.bed -b ../main_capture_analysis/peaky_called_unique_genes.bed > Adipose_Subcutaneous_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed
# 
# bedtools intersect -wo -a AdipoExpress_snps_lifted.bed -b ../main_capture_analysis/peaky_called_unique_genes.bed > AdipoExpress_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed
# 
# bedtools intersect -wo -a FUSION_ge_adipose_naive_snps_lifted.bed -b ../main_capture_analysis/peaky_called_unique_genes.bed > FUSION_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed
# 
# bedtools intersect -wo -a TwinsUK_ge_fat_snps_lifted.bed -b ../main_capture_analysis/peaky_called_unique_genes.bed > TwinsUK_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed


TwinsUK <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/capoverlaps/TwinsUK_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed")
FUSION <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/capoverlaps/FUSION_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed")
# AdipoExpress <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/capoverlaps/AdipoExpress_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed") # has too many unuseable gene IDs, have to ask genetics ppl like GATL when he's back
Adipose_Subcutaneous <- fread("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/capoverlaps/Adipose_Subcutaneous_intersect_peaky_called_genes.bed")


# merge/collapse/unique

all_eQTLs <- bind_rows(TwinsUK, FUSION, Adipose_Subcutaneous, .id = "origin") # excluded AdipoExpress for now

has_eQTLs <- all_eQTLs %>% 
    dplyr::select(fragment_chr = V5, fragment_start = V6, fragment_stop = V7,
           eQTL_gene = V4, MPCC = V11, peaky_nominated = V15) %>% 
    group_by(fragment_chr, fragment_start, fragment_stop)


# Map eQTL genes to official symbols
eqtl_mapped <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = has_eQTLs$eQTL_gene, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ALIAS", multiVals = "first")
eqtl_mapped_table <- as.data.frame(eqtl_mapped) %>% 
    cbind(original_eqtl_names = names(eqtl_mapped)) 


# Map peaky genes to official symbols
hg38_mapped <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = has_eQTLs$peaky_nominated, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ALIAS", multiVals = "first")
hg38_mapped_table <- as.data.frame(hg38_mapped) %>% 
    cbind(original_hg38_names = names(hg38_mapped))

# Map peaky genes to official symbols, from ensemblIDs
hg38_mapped_ens <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = has_eQTLs$peaky_nominated, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
hg38_mapped_table_ens <- as.data.frame(hg38_mapped_ens) %>% 
    cbind(original_hg38_ens_names = names(hg38_mapped_ens)) 



### merge and continue 


# cbind bc they're all the one size, should be the same 
eQTLs_genes_unified <- cbind(has_eQTLs, unified_eQTL_name =eqtl_mapped_table$eqtl_mapped, unified_peaky_name = hg38_mapped_table$hg38_mapped)

eQTLs_genes_unified$unified_peaky_name <- ifelse(is.na(eQTLs_genes_unified$unified_peaky_name),
                                               hg38_mapped_table_ens$hg38_mapped_ens,
                                               eQTLs_genes_unified$unified_peaky_name)



expanded <- eQTLs_genes_unified %>% 
    mutate(is_nominated_by_eQTL = ifelse(unified_eQTL_name == unified_peaky_name, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
    distinct()


# add daap6 etc.
# above stringent threshold
# above standard threshold


# add daap8
# above stringent threshold
# above standard threshold


```

```{r expression}

# DAAP6 expression --------------------------------------------------------

DAAP6_expression <- fread("DAAP6_RNAseq_results_APs_v_mADs.csv")

### careful, need to unify the genes again

# first the unique genes
# Map genes to official symbols
unique_genes_mapped <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = unique_genes$V11, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ALIAS", multiVals = "first")
unique_genes_mapped_table <- as.data.frame(unique_genes_mapped) %>% 
    cbind(original_unique_names = names(unique_genes_mapped)) 

# Map ensembl genes to official symbols, from ensemblIDs
unique_mapped_ens <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = unique_genes$V11, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
unique_mapped_table_ens <- as.data.frame(unique_mapped_ens) %>% 
    cbind(original_unique_ens_names = names(unique_mapped_ens)) 

#cbind is fine, same sizes
unique_genes_unified <- cbind(unique_genes, unified_unique_gene_name = unique_genes_mapped_table$unique_genes_mapped)

unique_genes_unified$unified_unique_gene_name <- ifelse(is.na(unique_genes_unified$unified_unique_gene_name),
                                               unique_mapped_table_ens$unique_mapped_ens,
                                               unique_genes_unified$unified_unique_gene_name)

# then the DAAP6_expression

DAAP6_mapped <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = DAAP6_expression$symbol, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ALIAS", multiVals = "first")
# gives large list...
DAAP6_mapped_table <- stack(DAAP6_mapped) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(original_gene_symbol = ind, unified_gene_symbol = values)


# no ensembl gene ids in the DAAP6 dataset thankfully

DAAP6_genes_unified <- cbind(DAAP6_expression, unified_DAAP6_gene_name = DAAP6_mapped_table$unified_gene_symbol)

###

unique_expression <- merge(unique_genes_unified, DAAP6_genes_unified, by.x = "unified_unique_gene_name", by.y = "unified_DAAP6_gene_name")

temp_expanded <- left_join(expanded, unique_expression, by = c("unified_peaky_name" = "V11"))

###

expanded_expression <- temp_expanded %>% 
    mutate(has_differential_exp_data = ifelse(unified_unique_gene_name == unified_peaky_name, TRUE, FALSE),
           gene_description = description,
           DAPP6_log2foldchange = log2FoldChange,
           DAAP6_padj = padj,
           DAAP6_direction = direction,
           DAAP6_unified_gene = unified_unique_gene_name,
           pass_standard_threshold_diff = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1 & padj < 0.05 ,TRUE, FALSE),
           pass_stringent_threshold_diff = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1.6 & padj < 0.01,TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-(starts_with("V")), -symbol, -biotype, -description, -log2FoldChange, -padj, -direction, -unified_unique_gene_name) %>% 
    distinct()


# table(unique_expression$direction)
# hist(unique_expression$log2FoldChange, breaks = 30)
# 
# hist(unique_expression$padj)
# 
# table(unique_expression$padj <0.05)
# table(unique_expression$padj <0.01)
# 
# table(unique_expression$log2FoldChange < -1 | unique_expression$log2FoldChange > 1)
# table(abs(unique_expression$log2FoldChange)> 1)
# 
# table(unique_expression$log2FoldChange < -1.6 | unique_expression$log2FoldChange > 1.6)


unique_expression_thresholded <- unique_expression %>% 
    transmute(padj_005 = unique_expression$padj <0.05,
              padj_001 = unique_expression$padj <0.01, 
              log_1 = unique_expression$log2FoldChange < -1 | unique_expression$log2FoldChange > 1,
              log_16 = unique_expression$log2FoldChange < -1.6 | unique_expression$log2FoldChange > 1.6)

thresholded_long <- unique_expression_thresholded %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "threshold", values_to = "value")

# Create a summary data frame with counts of true vs false for each threshold
summary_df <- thresholded_long %>%
    group_by(threshold, value) %>%
    summarise(count = n()) %>%
    ungroup()

# Create the grouped bar chart
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = threshold, y = count, fill = value)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5) +
    labs(title = "Different Thresholds",
         x = "Threshold",
         y = "Count",
         fill = "Value") +
    theme_minimal()
# different thresholds
# padj < 0.05
# padj < 0.01
# log2fold threshold of +/-1 (translates to 2 fold)
# or log2fold threshold of +/- 1.6 (translates to 3 fold)

# insulin resistance screen BBND, same padj and log2fold thresholding (if she has gene counts?, or caesar)
# 8 pie charts 
# one per threshold

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = threshold, y = count, fill = value)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = "Different Thresholds",
         x = "Threshold",
         y = "Count",
         fill = "Value") +
    theme_minimal()

# use log fold change of 1, padj = 0.01

### merge onto the expanded table




```

```{r}

# repeat the DAAP6 expression analysis with bRNAseq_ Human Adipocyte Transdifferentiation csv
# uses DAAP8 

transdiff <- readxl::read_xlsx("bRNAseq_ Human Adipocyte Transdifferentiation.xlsx")

unique_transdiff <- merge(unique_genes, transdiff, by.x = "V11", by.y = "symbol")

#table(unique_transdiff$direction)
hist(unique_transdiff$log2FoldChange, breaks = 30)

hist(unique_transdiff$padj)


table(unique_transdiff$padj <0.05)
table(unique_transdiff$padj <0.01)

table(unique_transdiff$log2FoldChange < -1 | unique_transdiff$log2FoldChange > 1)
table(unique_transdiff$log2FoldChange < -1.6 | unique_transdiff$log2FoldChange > 1.6)


# DAAP8 expression --------------------------------------------------------


### careful, need to unify the genes again

# unique genes already done

# then the DAAP8 expression, which usefully has a fully complete ensgene column

DAAP8_mapped <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = transdiff$ensgene, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")

DAAP8_mapped_table <- as.data.frame(DAAP8_mapped) 

# same size so can cbind
DAAP8_genes_unified <- cbind(transdiff, unified_DAAP8_gene_name = DAAP8_mapped_table$DAAP8_mapped) %>% 
    as.data.table() %>% 
    na.omit() # repeat for the other ones

###

unique_transdifferentiation <- left_join(unique_genes_unified, DAAP8_genes_unified, by= c( "unified_unique_gene_name" = "unified_DAAP8_gene_name"), relationship = "many-to-many")

temp_expanded <- left_join(expanded_expression, unique_transdifferentiation, by = c("unified_peaky_name" = "V11"))

###

expanded_transdifferentiation <- temp_expanded %>% 
    mutate(has_transdiff_data = ifelse(unified_unique_gene_name == unified_peaky_name, TRUE, FALSE),
           pass_standard_threshold_transdiff = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1 & padj < 0.05 ,TRUE, FALSE),
           pass_stringent_threshold_transdiff = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1.6 & padj < 0.01,TRUE, FALSE),
           DAPP8_log2foldchange = log2FoldChange,
           DAAP8_padj = padj,
           DAAP8_basemean = baseMean) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-(starts_with("V")), -symbol, -biotype, -description, -log2FoldChange, -padj, -unified_unique_gene_name, -ensgene) %>% 
    distinct()

table(expanded_transdifferentiation$pass_standard_threshold_transdiff)

table(expanded_transdifferentiation$pass_stringent_threshold_transdiff)


table(expanded_transdifferentiation$pass_standard_threshold_transdiff | expanded_transdifferentiation$pass_standard_threshold_diff)

pass_either <- expanded_transdifferentiation %>% 
    ungroup(.) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(pass_standard_threshold_diff == TRUE | pass_standard_threshold_transdiff == TRUE) %>% 
    distinct(peaky_nominated)

dim(pass_either)

knitr::kable(pass_either) %>% 
        kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "responsive", "bordered"))


table(expanded_transdifferentiation$pass_standard_threshold_transdiff & expanded_transdifferentiation$pass_standard_threshold_diff)
# list which genes are the ones that pass the standard daap6 and daap8 
pass_both <- expanded_transdifferentiation %>% 
    ungroup(.) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(pass_standard_threshold_diff == TRUE & pass_standard_threshold_transdiff == TRUE) %>% 
    distinct(peaky_nominated)


dim(pass_both)
knitr::kable(pass_both) %>% 
        kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "responsive", "bordered"))


# see if you can view the table in the gwalkr

## collapsed table by viewpoint

collapsed <- expanded_transdifferentiation %>% 
    group_by(fragment_chr, fragment_start, fragment_stop) %>% 
    summarize(eqtl_overlap_peaky_genes = paste(unique(eQTL_gene[is_nominated_by_eQTL == TRUE] ), collapse = ","),
              passes_standard_differentiation_threshold = paste(unique(peaky_nominated[pass_standard_threshold_diff == TRUE] ), collapse = ","),
              passes_strict_differentiation_threshold = paste(unique(peaky_nominated[pass_stringent_threshold_diff == TRUE] ), collapse = ","),
              passes_standard_insulin_threshold = paste(unique(peaky_nominated[pass_standard_threshold_transdiff == TRUE] ), collapse = ","),
              passes_strict_insulin_threshold = paste(unique(peaky_nominated[pass_stringent_threshold_transdiff == TRUE] ), collapse = ","))

head(collapsed) # change name, rosiglitasone +/- treatment, energy expenditure
```

```{bash peakyvschicane}


mkdir peak_comparisons
cd peak_comparisons

### compare all peaks

cat ../plot_sig_mpcc.bedGraph > peaky.bed
cat ../../../CHiCANE/M1_results_005_bedtools.bed > chicane.bed

bedtools intersect -a chicane.bed -b peaky.bed -wao > all_peaks_intersection.bed
wc -l all_peaks_intersection.bed
# may need to run peaky on the remaining viewpoints...

### compare all TSS's

bedtools intersect M1_results_005_bedtools.bed all_tss.bed -wao > M1_genes_tss.bed

bedtools intersect peaky.bed all_tss.bed -wao > peaky_genes_tss.bed

bedtools intersect M1_genes_tss.bed peaky_genes_tss.bed -wao > all_genes_intersection.bed

wc -l all_genes_intersection.bed

```
